name: Deepgram
description: Two prerecorded Nova-3 speech-to-text queries for English or supported multilingual/code-switching audio. Only public HTTPS links on operator-approved hosts to mono integer PCM WAV recordings up to 120 seconds/12 MB are supported. Returns transcript, word timestamps and optional speaker labels; no streaming, speech generation, uploads or audio conversion.

queries.name: Deepgram English audio transcription
queries.description: Transcribe English audio using Nova-3. audio_url must be a public HTTPS link on an operator-approved host to mono integer PCM WAV: at most 120 seconds and 12 MB, 8–48 kHz sample rate, 8/16/24/32-bit samples. Returns transcript, confidence, duration, word timestamps and request ID. Optional diarize (default false) adds speaker labels; smart_format defaults to true. MP3/M4A, stereo audio, local files, uploads, streaming and format conversion are not supported. Flat $0.02 per successful request.

audio_url.description: HTTPS URL to a mono PCM WAV recording, at most 120 seconds and 12 MB, on an operator-approved audio host. 8–48 kHz, 8/16/24/32-bit integer samples. For the hosted OpenMCP demo, use https://openmcp.vercel.app/samples/openmcp-demo.wav. Other recording hosts need operator approval. Not an arbitrary website or local file path.

diarize.description: Label speakers in word timestamps. Included in the prerecorded price.
